name: The First Harvest
beat: Pure build sprint; the village learns it can finish something.

ceremony.warning: Dust on the west road is only dust — this time. Fill the granary before dusk.
ceremony.victory: The granary stands full and the bell rings long. The Manner has finished something.
ceremony.defeat: The stores ran short and the bell rang thin. Eat, sleep, walk the road again.

description: A village begins with a full granary. Raise farms and bring home the first harvest.

name: Hold the Timber Line
beat: First blood; gather under pressure.

ceremony.warning: Polemen on the Timber Line. Cut fast and keep the tower manned.
ceremony.victory: The road crews broke on our walls. The timber piles high.
ceremony.defeat: The toll-gangs took their cut in timber. Mend the walls and go again.

description: Raiders have found the road. Gather timber while keeping the manor standing.

name: The Long Night
beat: Small garrison, two raids, moonstone hunger.

ceremony.warning: Two bands out tonight, hungry for moonstone. Light every lamp.
ceremony.victory: Dawn comes grey and the coffers shine. The village endures.
ceremony.defeat: The night outlasted our stores. The manor stands — barely. Try again fed.

description: Secure moonstone before dawn. Defend the manor through two raids with a small garrison.

name: The Ember Road
beat: Tight clock, a long quiet stretch, then one late raid.

ceremony.warning: Charcoal pads and quiet woods. Mind the clock — something walks at dusk.
ceremony.victory: The forge-fire eats and the road is ours one more night.
ceremony.defeat: The kilns went cold before the carts filled. Walk it again, faster.

description: A forge-fire needs feeding. Cut timber fast on a tight clock while a single late raid tests the new watchfire.

name: Moonwell Plenty
beat: Split economy; foragers earn their keep.

ceremony.warning: Bread for the tables, ore for the coffers. Two hungers, one night.
ceremony.victory: Full tables, heavy coffers. The Hollow gives to those who dig.
ceremony.defeat: One hunger or the other went unfed. Balance the crews and return.

description: Two hungers at once: bread for the tables, moonstone for the coffers. Foragers earn their keep while raiders circle twice.

name: The Last Stand
beat: Skeleton crew, three waves before dawn, finale.

ceremony.warning: Three waves before dawn, five souls to hold them. Ring the bell.
ceremony.victory: Three waves broke and the bell still rings. Carve your name on it.
ceremony.defeat: The third wave took the night. The village crawls back with salvage — as always.

description: Three waves before dawn with a skeleton crew. Hold the manor, keep the gold flowing, and prove the village endures.

name: Ashen Ford
beat: Rush-defense; a stone wall holds the ford while the mine pays.

ceremony.warning: Ash and shallow water. Hold the ford, keep the mine singing, and mind the second horn.
ceremony.victory: The ford held and the pike-line never broke. The village has a new road — and new spears.
ceremony.defeat: The ford ran red and the raiders crossed. Rebuild the line and try the crossing again.

description: Raiders press the ashen ford. Hold a stone wall with a lean crew and keep moonstone flowing through two raids.

name: Hollow Dam
beat: Escort-economy; pikewomen screen the harvest crews.

ceremony.warning: Bread and stone both, and the hollow is thirsty work. The pikewomen walk screen — keep them fed.
ceremony.victory: Full tables, quiet water. The dam crews swear by the pike-line now — and the masons took notes.
ceremony.defeat: The crews scattered and the dam stood half-built. Feed them better and walk them home.

description: Two hungers at the hollow dam: bread for the tables, stone for the walls. Pikewomen screen two raids while the crews haul.

name: Coin and Cinder
beat: Two roads meet at one market; coin for the crossing, cinder for the forge.

ceremony.warning: Two roads, one market. Sarella Emberwright's coin backs every stall — fill the coffers and the cold piles before the second horn.
ceremony.victory: Coin counted, cinder banked. Sarella's stalls stand and the wild market is open — the Manner trades on its own terms now.
ceremony.defeat: The stalls stood empty and the raiders took their toll. Sarella keeps the ledger — walk the road again and settle it.

description: Sarella Emberwright stakes a wild market where the forked roads rejoin. Hold the crossing, keep moonstone and frostwood flowing through two raids, and open the stalls.

name: The Pale Host
beat: The war band grows up; wave-scaled raiders test the oathbound line.

ceremony.warning: Bell-Captain Sorrel holds the Old Bell line. The pale host comes in climbing waves - swear the oath and hold.
ceremony.victory: The pale host broke on the oath-line. Sorrel chalked every name. The Oathstone stands and the heavy guard is sworn.
ceremony.defeat: The waves kept climbing and the line bent. Sorrel sounds the retreat in good order: swear again, hold longer, mind the horns.

description: Bell-Captain Sorrel, successor of the Old Bell, holds a ridge against climbing raider waves. Survive three steepening assaults and keep moonstone flowing.

name: Red Banner
beat: Shield wall doctrine: halberds forward, stones high, no ground given.

ceremony.warning: Take the red banner, plant the shieldwall, and let the halberds do the talking. Hold the ridge the melee way.
ceremony.victory: The ridge held under red. The shieldwall never took a step back - and the grey scouts took notes for their own road.
ceremony.defeat: The line bent and the red went down in the mud. Pick it up, plant it deeper, and hold.

description: The Red Banner flies for the shield wall: halberdiers shoulder to shoulder behind stone, arrows a rumor from the far ridge. Hold three raids the melee way.

name: Grey Banner
beat: Arrow storm doctrine: grey cloaks in the pines, the ridge swept clean.

ceremony.warning: Take the grey banner, string the longbows, and let the pines do the hiding. Sweep the ridge the ranged way.
ceremony.victory: The ridge stands swept under grey. Not a raider reached the stones - and the red guard took notes for their own road.
ceremony.defeat: The strings snapped and the ridge went quiet. Restring, rehide, and loose again.

description: The Grey Banner flies for the arrow storm: longbowmen grey-cloaked in the pines, stones a rumor from the far ridge. Hold three raids the ranged way.

name: The Pale Court
beat: The unchosen banner returns; the sky itself gets a vote.
log: The Envoy quoted the oldest legend word for word, then asked for nothing but a road. The court is pale, the terms are plain, and both banners fly over it.

ceremony.warning: The Pale Envoy waits where the banners meet, pale as moonrise. She quotes the old legend — "the court sits where two roads kneel" — and bids you hold her court through two raids.
ceremony.victory: The court held, and both banners fly over it now — red and grey together. The Envoy bowed once and left a dial, a gift, and a cloak of the other color.
ceremony.defeat: The court scattered before the second horn. The Envoy waited, patient as winter, for you to try the road again.

description: The Pale Envoy holds court at Southreach Crossing, where the old roads kneel together. Claim the crossing, hold two raids, and reunite the doctrine.

name: The Longest Night
beat: Hardest raid in the game; oathbound wardens hold the line that must not break.
log: Sorrel chalked the oathbound names herself and set a lantern at every cairn. The night outlasted — barely — and the dawn owes us one.

ceremony.warning: Bell-Captain Sorrel holds the Old Bell line one last time: three steep waves, nine souls, and the night that outlasted its name. Swear the oath if you dare.
ceremony.victory: The longest night broke at last. Sorrel chalked every name — the living on the bell, the fallen on the cairns. Squires stood where wardens fell.
ceremony.defeat: The night outlasted, as the old song warned. Sorrel sounds the retreat in good order: swear again, hold longer, mind the horns.

description: Sorrel stakes everything on Starwatch Ridge: claim the height, then survive three steepening assaults — the hardest raid the Manner has seen.

name: Dawn
beat: Four-wave final siege; the whole Manner holds one ridge at first light.
log: Twelve givers stood the last ridge together — Issa, Tomm, Maro, Sarella, Fen, Wren, Pella, Sorrel, Rue, Tam, Old Bell, and the Pale Envoy. The eldest of the village was named Moonwarden, and dawn came up like a held breath let go.

ceremony.warning: Issa unrolls the finished chart: four waves before first light, ten souls, every giver on the ridge. Hold till dawn, and the Manner earns its name.
ceremony.victory: Dawn breaks over the Manner — Issa, Tomm, Maro, Sarella, Fen, Wren, Pella, Sorrel, Rue, Tam, Old Bell and the Pale Envoy standing one line. The eldest is named Moonwarden, the Gate stands open, and the credits are chalked in gold.
ceremony.defeat: The dark held past first light. Twelve givers, one ridge, and the dawn still coming — walk it again, all together.

description: The final siege waits in the Dawnfields beyond the southern road. Claim the fields, carry the whole Manner there, and hold four waves until first light.

name: Break the Border Patrol
beat: First blood of the conquest: scatter the shield-pairs on the west road.
description: The Ironshield patrol the west road in pairs, and every survivor carries a horn. Break them before the keep learns your name.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel marks the road on the chart: two waves of shield-pairs, one banner on the ridge. Break the patrol before the horn answers.
ceremony.victory: The shield-pairs fall back past the ridge, horns silent. The road to the keep lies open.
ceremony.defeat: The patrol held the road. The horns carried, and the keep is warned — walk it again.

name: Silence the Watch Post
beat: Three waves under a stone watch — blind the horn before the keep answers.
description: A stone watch above the valley answers every horn the Ironshield sound. Hold the ascent and silence it — or fight the whole keep awake.

ceremony.warning: Three waves climb toward the watch. Hold the ascent for four minutes and the horn dies with the tower.
ceremony.victory: The watch burns quiet. Below, the Ironshield keep stands blind and half-asleep.
ceremony.defeat: The watch answered every wave with a horn. The keep is awake now — climb again.

name: The Ironshield Keep
beat: The conquest finale: four waves and the Warden-Captain himself in the keep yard.
log: The shields broke at the fourth horn. Brannoc fought from the gate to the yard and did not ask for quarter, and when it was over the valley belonged to the Manner — road, stores and stone.
description: The keep waits at the valley's heart behind stone and shield-lines. Carry the campaign stores, weather four waves, and put the Warden-Captain down where the kept stone stands.

raids.herald: 🛡 The keep gates grind open — WARDEN-CAPTAIN BRANNOC takes the yard at wave {wave}! Shields to the front!

ceremony.warning: Sorrel rolls the last chart tight: four horns, thirty shields, and the Warden-Captain at the end of them. The muster and the campaign stores march together — or not at all.
ceremony.victory: The fourth horn breaks. Brannoc falls in his own yard, the shields stack at the gate, and the valley — road, stores and stone — belongs to the Manner.
ceremony.defeat: The keep held. The shields are still standing and the valley is still theirs — carry a fuller chest and a harder muster next time.

name: Cut the Snare Lines
beat: Cut the snared paths through Whisperwood. Break two waves of raiders before their scouts can warn the briar camp.
description: Cut the snared paths through Whisperwood. Break two waves of raiders before their scouts can warn the briar camp.

ceremony.warning: Cut the snared paths through Whisperwood. Break two waves of raiders before their scouts can warn the briar camp.
ceremony.victory: The snares are cut. The road to the briar camp lies open.
ceremony.defeat: The Thornband still hold the forest paths. Gather your stores and march again.

name: Burn the Briar Camp
beat: The Thornband camp shelters raiders beneath the forest canopy. Hold the paths through three waves and burn their warning fires.
description: The Thornband camp shelters raiders beneath the forest canopy. Hold the paths through three waves and burn their warning fires.

ceremony.warning: The Thornband camp shelters raiders beneath the forest canopy. Hold the paths through three waves and burn their warning fires.
ceremony.victory: The camp burns quiet. Vex waits within the hold.
ceremony.defeat: The Thornband still hold the forest paths. Gather your stores and march again.

name: The Briar Hold
beat: Carry the campaign stores into Whisperwood, hold the briar yard through four waves, and defeat Briar-Captain Vex.
log: Vex fell at the fourth horn, and the raiders scattered beneath the trees. The briar paths, timber and stores passed to the Manner.
description: Carry the campaign stores into Whisperwood, hold the briar yard through four waves, and defeat Briar-Captain Vex.

raids.herald: 🌿 The briar gates open - BRIAR-CAPTAIN VEX takes the yard at wave {wave}! Hold the forest paths!

ceremony.warning: Carry the campaign stores into Whisperwood, hold the briar yard through four waves, and defeat Briar-Captain Vex.
ceremony.victory: Vex falls in the briar yard. Whisperwood belongs to the Manner.
ceremony.defeat: The Thornband still hold the forest paths. Gather your stores and march again.

name: Break the Slag Lines
beat: Break the slag barricades in the hills of Ashfall March. Hold the road through two waves before the wall-breakers can warn the forge.
description: Break the slag barricades in the hills of Ashfall March. Hold the road through two waves before the wall-breakers can warn the forge.

ceremony.warning: Break the slag barricades in the hills of Ashfall March. Hold the road through two waves before the wall-breakers can warn the forge.
ceremony.victory: The slag lines crumble. The road to the war forge lies open.
ceremony.defeat: The Cinder Clan still hold the ash roads. Gather your stores and march again.

name: Quench the Forge
beat: Quench the Cinder war forge. Hold the ash roads through three waves and cut the wall-breakers off from fresh iron.
description: Quench the Cinder war forge. Hold the ash roads through three waves and cut the wall-breakers off from fresh iron.

ceremony.warning: Quench the Cinder war forge. Hold the ash roads through three waves and cut the wall-breakers off from fresh iron.
ceremony.victory: The forge falls silent. Sorr waits within the citadel.
ceremony.defeat: The Cinder Clan still hold the ash roads. Gather your stores and march again.

name: The Cinder Citadel
beat: Carry the campaign stores into Ashfall March, hold the citadel yard through four waves, and defeat Furnace-Captain Sorr.
log: Sorr fell at the fourth horn, and the breakers scattered through the ash. The hill roads and forge stores passed to the Manner.
description: Carry the campaign stores into Ashfall March, hold the citadel yard through four waves, and defeat Furnace-Captain Sorr.

raids.herald: 🔥 The furnace gates open - FURNACE-CAPTAIN SORR takes the yard at wave {wave}! Hold the ash roads!

ceremony.warning: Carry the campaign stores into Ashfall March, hold the citadel yard through four waves, and defeat Furnace-Captain Sorr.
ceremony.victory: Sorr falls in the furnace yard. Ashfall March belongs to the Manner.
ceremony.defeat: The Cinder Clan still hold the ash roads. Gather your stores and march again.

name: Turn the Tide Lines
beat: Turn the tide lines along the Pale Coast. Hold the shore through two waves while enemy bowmen press from the sea mist.
description: Turn the tide lines along the Pale Coast. Hold the shore through two waves while enemy bowmen press from the sea mist.

ceremony.warning: Turn the tide lines along the Pale Coast. Hold the shore through two waves while enemy bowmen press from the sea mist.
ceremony.victory: The tide lines fall quiet. The mist camp lies open.
ceremony.defeat: The Pale Host still hold the shore. Gather your stores and march again.

name: Scatter the Mist
beat: Scatter the mist camp on the Pale Coast. Hold the shore through three waves and cut the bowmen off from the court.
description: Scatter the mist camp on the Pale Coast. Hold the shore through three waves and cut the bowmen off from the court.

ceremony.warning: Scatter the mist camp on the Pale Coast. Hold the shore through three waves and cut the bowmen off from the court.
ceremony.victory: The mist scatters. The Grey Herald waits within the court.
ceremony.defeat: The Pale Host still hold the shore. Gather your stores and march again.

name: The Pale Court
beat: Carry the campaign stores to the Pale Coast, hold the court through four waves, and defeat The Grey Herald amid ranged arrow volleys.
log: The Grey Herald fell at the fourth horn, and the bowmen scattered through the sea mist. The coastal roads and court stores passed to the Manner.
description: Carry the campaign stores to the Pale Coast, hold the court through four waves, and defeat The Grey Herald amid ranged arrow volleys.

raids.herald: The mist parts - THE GREY HERALD takes the shore at wave {wave}! Hold the Pale Coast!

ceremony.warning: Carry the campaign stores to the Pale Coast, hold the court through four waves, and defeat The Grey Herald amid ranged arrow volleys.
ceremony.victory: The Grey Herald falls. The Pale Coast belongs to the Manner.
ceremony.defeat: The Pale Host still hold the shore. Gather your stores and march again.

name: Break the Vanguard
beat: Break the veteran vanguard on Starwatch Ridge. Hold the hill road through two waves before the disciplined lines close the pass.
description: Break the veteran vanguard on Starwatch Ridge. Hold the hill road through two waves before the disciplined lines close the pass.

ceremony.warning: Break the veteran vanguard on Starwatch Ridge. Hold the hill road through two waves before the disciplined lines close the pass.
ceremony.victory: The vanguard breaks. The siege redoubt lies open.
ceremony.defeat: The Ember Legion still hold the ridge. Gather your stores and march again.

name: Storm the Redoubt
beat: Storm the siege redoubt on Starwatch Ridge. Hold the heights through three waves and cut the engines off from the throne.
description: Storm the siege redoubt on Starwatch Ridge. Hold the heights through three waves and cut the engines off from the throne.

ceremony.warning: Storm the siege redoubt on Starwatch Ridge. Hold the heights through three waves and cut the engines off from the throne.
ceremony.victory: The redoubt falls. Legion-Marshal Cindral waits at the throne.
ceremony.defeat: The Ember Legion still hold the ridge. Gather your stores and march again.

name: The Ember Throne
beat: Carry the campaign stores to Starwatch Ridge, hold the throne through four waves, and defeat Legion-Marshal Cindral amid veteran infantry and siege pressure.
log: Legion-Marshal Cindral fell at the fourth horn, and the disciplined lines broke. The ridge passes and throne stores passed to the Manner.
description: Carry the campaign stores to Starwatch Ridge, hold the throne through four waves, and defeat Legion-Marshal Cindral amid veteran infantry and siege pressure.

raids.herald: The ridge burns - LEGION-MARSHAL CINDRAL marches at wave {wave}! Hold Starwatch Ridge!

ceremony.warning: Carry the campaign stores to Starwatch Ridge, hold the throne through four waves, and defeat Legion-Marshal Cindral amid veteran infantry and siege pressure.
ceremony.victory: Cindral falls. Starwatch Ridge belongs to the Manner.
ceremony.defeat: The Ember Legion still hold the ridge. Gather your stores and march again.

name: The Grey Dawn Gathers
beat: Five fallen territories muster their banners at the Manner; two scout waves test the home fields before the true Grey Dawn assault.
description: The five territories have fallen. Muster their banners on the home fields and turn back two waves of Grey Dawn scouts before the true assault.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel calls the five banners to the Muster Fields. Grey Dawn scouts come in two waves; hold the home ground before the true assault.
ceremony.victory: The scouts fall back. Five banners stand together at the Manner, and Sorrel watches the grey horizon.
ceremony.defeat: The scouts scatter the muster. Sorrel gathers the fallen banners; form the line again before the Grey Dawn comes.

name: Muster of the Five Banners
beat: Five fallen territories drill together on the Banner Field; three probing waves test the mustered lines.
description: Grey Dawn outriders probe the five banners in three waves. Hold the Banner Field and keep the oathstone standing.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel calls the five banners to drill on the Banner Field. Three waves probe the lines; hold the field and keep the oathstone standing.
ceremony.victory: The outriders fall back. The five banners hold the Banner Field together, and Sorrel watches the grey horizon.
ceremony.defeat: The outriders break the muster. Sorrel gathers the fallen banners; form the line again before the Grey Dawn comes.

name: The Grey Road
beat: The drilled banners march onto the Grey Road; the heaviest probe tests their last muster before the assault.
description: Three heavy waves probe the Grey Road. Hold the road, keep the oathstone standing, and break the probe.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel leads the drilled banners onto the Grey Road. Three heavy waves come; hold the road and keep the oathstone standing before the final assault.
ceremony.victory: The probe breaks. The five banners hold the Grey Road, and Sorrel turns their march toward the final assault.
ceremony.defeat: The probe breaks the road line. Sorrel gathers the fallen banners; muster again and hold the Grey Road.

name: The Grey Dawn Crown
beat: At first light the true Grey Dawn breaks on the Muster Fields; five banners hold Crown Ridge against their Sovereign.
description: The five banners hold one ridge on the Muster Fields at first light. Weather four horns, keep the oathstone standing, and bring down the Grey Sovereign to end the campaign.

raids.herald: The first light breaks on Crown Ridge ? THE GREY SOVEREIGN takes the field at wave {wave}! Five banners, hold the ridge!

ceremony.warning: Sorrel calls the final assault: four horns on the Muster Fields, the oathstone on Crown Ridge, and the Sovereign at first light. Carry the full war chest and hold the five banners together.
ceremony.victory: The Grey Sovereign falls. The five banners hold Crown Ridge as daylight reaches the Muster Fields. Sorrel lowers the last chart: the Grey Dawn is broken, and the campaign is won.
ceremony.defeat: The Sovereign holds Crown Ridge. Sorrel gathers the five banners from the Muster Fields; fill the war chest and return for the final dawn.

name: The Ashen Wake
beat: The Crown is broken but its embers walk; Sorrel reads the first ash-fall drifting over the Muster Fields.
description: Ember survivors scatter from Crown Ridge toward the Marches. Hold the muster ground through three horns and cut down their vanguard.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel reads ash on the wind: three horns of Ember survivors on the Muster Fields, hungry and leaderless. Hold the ground and cut the vanguard down.
ceremony.victory: The vanguard breaks on the muster ground. Prisoners talk of five camp-fires in the wilds — Thornband snares first, under the northern pines.
ceremony.defeat: The survivors slip through toward the Marches. Sorrel holds the muster ground; fill the war chest and meet the next horns ready.

name: The Whisper Snare
beat: Thornband snares tighten along the northern road; the Cut-Camp under the pines must burn.
description: Push into Whisperwood forest and burn out the Thornband Cut-Camp. Break three horns under the pines and stand the muster.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel marks the pines: the Cut-Camp that watched the northern road now sets snares for muster columns. Three horns in the Whisperwood — burn the camp out.
ceremony.victory: The Cut-Camp burns. Thornband lookouts flee east toward the ridge, where pale cloth flies over Starwatch and the Host keeps its low fires.
ceremony.defeat: The snares hold the column off. Sorrel falls back to the road; fill the war chest and cut the pines lane by lane.

name: The Starwatch Veil
beat: Pale cloth on the ridge; the Host keeps low fires and watches every approach.
description: Climb Starwatch Ridge and tear the Pale Host Watch from its cliffs. Break three horns in the thin air and stand the muster.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel glasses the ridge: white cloth below the skyline, low fires, watched approaches. The Pale Host Watch has never been stormed — be the first.
ceremony.victory: The Watch falls and its cloth burns like small suns. South along the old march road the Cinder slag-lines glow, and Ember works smoke behind them.
ceremony.defeat: The ridge keeps its veil. Sorrel leads the column down by dark; fill the war chest and climb again with heavier horns.

name: The Slag-Fire Lines
beat: Cinder slag-lines glow along the old march road; the road-camp's heavy rack must come down.
description: Break the Cinder Clan road-camp on the Ashfall March. Three horns among the slag-lines — or slip past to the Ember works instead.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel counts the slag-lines: a heavy timber rack, a blackened firepit, and breakers built for long stays. Three horns on the March — or strike the Ember works and let the slag-lines wait.
ceremony.victory: The road-camp falls and its rack burns. Behind the smoke the Ember Legion works hammer on, red canvas over stacked supplies.
ceremony.defeat: The slag-lines hold. Sorrel pulls the column off the March; fill the war chest and return — or try the Ember works instead.

name: The Ember Works
beat: Red canvas over stacked supplies; the Legion's field workshop must go quiet.
description: Storm the Ember Legion works on the Ashfall March. Three horns among the red canvas — or break the Cinder slag-lines instead.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel studies the red canvas: carts, timber frames, a field workshop feeding the whole March. Three horns at the works — or break the Cinder slag-lines and let the works wait.
ceremony.victory: The works go quiet and their canvas burns. South lies the salt grass of the Pale Coast, where pale banners stand in ceremonial rows.
ceremony.defeat: The works hold their yard. Sorrel pulls the column off the March; fill the war chest and return — or try the slag-lines instead.

name: The Pale Pavilion
beat: Pale banners stand in precise rows above the salt grass; the Shore Pavilion keeps its ceremonial order — until tonight.
description: Storm the Pale Court Shore Pavilion on the Pale Coast. Three horns among the salt grass, then the scorched ridge and the Warlord.

ceremony.warning: Sorrel walks the salt grass: pale banners in precise rows, supplies by rank, a camp with ceremonial order. Three horns at the pavilion — either March road earned the way here.
ceremony.victory: The pavilion falls silent and its banners burn. North rises the scorched ridge, and on it the Ashen Warlord waits for the full muster.
ceremony.defeat: The ceremonial rows hold. Sorrel pulls the column back to the Marches; fill the war chest and storm the salt grass again.

name: The Ashen Crown
beat: Beyond the broken Dawn the five camp-fires burn as one; the Ashen Warlord holds the scorched ridge and dares the Manner to take it.
description: Beyond the Muster Fields the Warlord holds the scorched Ashen Crown. Break four horns heavier than the Dawn, stand the full muster, and bring down the Crown of the Five Fires.

raids.herald: The ridge burns black — THE ASHEN WARLORD takes the field at wave {wave}! Five fires, one crown — hold!

ceremony.warning: Sorrel marks the scorched ridge: four horns heavier than the Dawn, the Warlord at the fourth, and no oathstone to hide behind — only the full muster and the war chest.
ceremony.victory: The Ashen Warlord falls. Five camp-fires gutter out along the frontier and the Manner takes the scorched crown. Sorrel charts the ridge under a new name: the Ashen Crown, first light of Act XI.
ceremony.defeat: The Warlord holds the scorched ridge. Sorrel pulls the muster back past the Marches; fill the war chest and return with heavier horns.
